headings: Condition of Physical Assets and Insurance
paragraphs: SSR Mining Inc. and its subsidiaries (collectively, "SSR Mining," or "Company") is a precious metals mining company with assets located in the United States, Türkiye, Canada and Argentina. The Company is primarily engaged in the operation, acquisition, exploration and development of precious metal resource properties located in Türkiye and the Americas. The Company produces gold doré as well as copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrates.

The Company's common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange ("TSX") in Canada and the Nasdaq Global Select Market ("Nasdaq") in the U.S. under the symbol "SSRM". SSR Mining voluntarily delisted from the Australian Securities Exchange ("ASX") in Australia under the symbol "SSR", effective April 8, 2025.

In this report, "SSR Mining," the "Company," "our," "us" and "we" refer to SSR Mining Inc. together with its affiliates and subsidiaries, unless the context otherwise requires. All currency references herein are in United States dollars ("USD") unless otherwise indicated. References to "CAD" or the use of the symbol "C$" refers to Canadian dollars. References to "TRY" are to the lawful currency of Türkiye, the Turkish Lira. References to "ARS" are to the lawful currency of Argentina, the Argentine peso.

The Company's operations consist of five reportable and operating segments for each of its producing mine sites - Çöpler, located in Erzincan Province, Türkiye ("Çöpler"), Marigold, located in Nevada, United States ("Marigold"), Crippler Creek & Victor, located in Colorado, United States ("CC&V"), Seabee, located in Saskatchewan, Canada ("Seabee"), and Puna, located in Jujuy Province, Argentina ("Puna") - each of which is a reportable operating segment and which are also referred to as producing assets. The contributions to revenue by reportable operating segment for the year ended December 31, 2025 were 0% from Çöpler (2024 – 7%; 2023 – 31%), 33% from Marigold (2024 – 41%; 2023 – 38%), 28% from CC&V, 11% from Seabee (2024 – 19%; 2023 – 11%) and 28% from Puna (2024 – 33%; 2023 – 20%). See Note 4 to the Consolidated Financial Statements for further information relating to reportable operating segments.

The Company also participates in exploration and development activities at properties located in the United States, Argentina, Canada and Türkiye. See Item 2. Properties, for further information about the Company's production, exploration and development properties.

Çöpler, Marigold, CC&V and Seabee produce gold doré. Doré consists of unrefined gold bullion bars that generally contain in excess of 90% gold, which is subsequently refined by a third party to gold bullion. The Company sells gold doré produced at Marigold, CC&V and Seabee primarily to banks, and sells gold doré produced at Çöpler, when operational, to the Central Bank of Türkiye. Puna produces silver, lead and zinc concentrates, which are sold to smelters or traders for further refining.

During 2025, sales of gold doré represented approximately 71% of total revenue, with 33% sold to Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce ("CIBC"), 13% sold to the Royal Bank of Canada ("RBC"), and 12% sold to the National Bank of Canada ("NBC"). Silver sales represented approximately 24% of revenue with 10% sold to Trafigura Trading LLC. During 2024, sales of gold doré accounted for 67% of revenue, with 30% sold to CIBC and 13% to Asahi Refining. During 2023, sales of gold doré accounted for 80% of revenue, with 33% sold to CIBC and 31% sold to Central Bank of Türkiye.

The Company sells lead and zinc concentrate with high silver content, through contractual arrangements with smelters and traders located in Asia and Europe. The concentrates are sold under supply contracts updated annually or as needed through spot sales, with processing fees based on the demand for the concentrates in the global marketplace.

(2) Other revenue includes: changes in the fair value of concentrate trade receivables due to changes in silver and base metal prices; and silver and copper by-product revenue arising from the production and sale of gold doré.
For information on the mineral resources and mineral reserves for each operating asset, see Item 2, "Proven and Probable Reserve Estimates by Mineral" and "Resource Estimates by Mineral."

The market prices of gold and silver are key drivers of the Company's profitability. The prices of gold and silver can fluctuate widely and are affected by a number of macroeconomic factors, including global or regional consumption patterns, the supply of, and demand for gold and silver, interest rates, exchange rates, inflation or deflation, and the political and economic conditions of major gold- and silver-producing and gold- and silver-consuming countries throughout the world. Importantly, the price of gold and silver can be impacted by their role as safe havens during periods of market turmoil and as defense against the perceived inflationary impacts and currency depreciation caused by the responses of governments and central banking authorities to various economic threats. See Item 1A. Risk Factors, for further information.

headings: Risks Related to the Çöpler Incident
Actual and potential losses and liability resulting from the Çöpler Incident could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity, cash flows and results of operations.
Ongoing investigations and remediation in connection with the Çöpler Incident could have a material adverse effect on the operation.
The Çöpler Incident may result in environmental contamination of the surrounding area.
The Company's production, development plans and cost estimates for Çöpler may not be achieved.
Responding to the Çöpler Incident, including progressing the remediation and restart efforts, requires significant management attention.
The Çöpler Incident could impact the ongoing development of Hod Maden.
The Company's access to capital in a timely manner and on acceptable terms may be negatively impacted by the Çöpler Incident.
The Company's insurance coverage may not cover all of the Company's potential losses, liabilities and damages related to Çöpler Incident.
The Company's share price may continue to be volatile.
Risks Related to the Company's Operations and Business
The Company's production, development plans and cost estimates may vary and/or not be achieved.
Changes in the market prices of gold, silver and other metals, which in the past have fluctuated widely, will affect the Company's operations.

The Company's estimates of mineral reserves and mineral resources are based on interpretation and assumptions and may yield less mineral production under actual conditions than is currently estimated.
The Company may be unable to replace its mineral reserves or acquire additional commercially mineable mineral rights.
The Company faces intense competition in the mining industry.
Increased operating and capital costs could affect the Company's profitability.
The Company is subject to supply chain disruptions and transportation risks.
The Company's operations may be adversely affected by rising energy prices or energy shortages.
Continuation of the Company's mining production is dependent on the availability of sufficient water supplies to support our mining operations.
The Company may be exposed to future development risks.
Land reclamation, mine closure and remediation requirements and costs may be burdensome and actual environmental and asset retirement obligations may exceed estimates and reserves.
The Company is subject to information systems security threats and other risks.
The Company's joint venture interests are subject to risks.
paragraphs: The Company is subject to a variety of risks and uncertainties which, if any such risk actually occurs, could have a material adverse effect on the Company's business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flow. You should carefully consider the risks presented in this section, together with the information included in other sections of this Annual Report. Such risks are not the only ones faced by the Company and additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also affect the Company's business and the effect could be material.

paragraphs: SSR Mining is a precious metals mining company with five operations located in the United States, Türkiye, Canada and Argentina. The Company is primarily engaged in the operation, acquisition, exploration and development of precious metal resource properties located in Türkiye and the Americas. The Company produces gold doré as well as copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrates.

During the second quarter of 2025, the Company temporarily suspended operations at Seabee for approximately two weeks due to power interruptions caused by forest fires to the north of the mine. The Company resumed operations on June 13, 2025 with no damage to the Company's property.

On February 28, 2025 ("Acquisition Date"), the Company acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Cripple Creek and Victor Gold Mining Company ("CC&V") from Newmont Corporation for $100.0 million in upfront consideration and up to $175.0 million in cash in additional milestone-based payments payable in connection with the approval to amend the permit application to extend the life of mine and obtaining regulatory relief relating to flow related permitting requirements. See Note 3 of the Consolidated Financial Statements for additional details related to the CC&V acquisition.

On February 13, 2024, the Company suspended all operations at its Çöpler property as a result of the Çöpler Incident. In partnership with the Turkish authorities, the Company is working to remediate the site, which includes a permanent closure of the heap leach pad and a cessation of heap leach processing. We continue to work closely with the relevant authorities to reinstate necessary regulatory approvals and advance the restart of the Çöpler mine. At this time, the Company is not able to estimate or predict when it will resume operations at Çöpler. See Part I. Business – Çöpler Incident for more information.

On May 23, 2024, the Company completed the sale of the San Luis project located in the Ancash department of central Peru to Highlander Silver Corp. ("Highlander Silver") in exchange for cash of $5.0 million and contingent consideration in the form of cash payments of up to $37.5 million. The fair value of the contingent consideration on the closing date was $2.4 million and is payable in six installments beginning with the commencement of an initial drilling program at the San Luis project and ending on the second anniversary of commercial production. The consideration received does not include certain payments that are contingent upon completion of a feasibility study and commercial production. The Company retained a 4% net smelter return royalty ("NSR") on the San Luis project, half of which can be repurchased by Highlander Silver for $15.0 million at any time until the commencement of construction.
For further information regarding the acquisitions and divestitures mentioned above, see Note 3 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.
SSR Mining Inc. 以及其子公司（合稱為 "SSR Mining" 或 "本公司"）為一家從事貴金屬採礦的公司，其資產位於美國、土耳其、加拿大及阿根廷。本公司主要從事貴金屬資源產地的經營、取得、探勘及開發，這些產地位於土耳其及美洲。本公司生產金 doré 以及銅、銀、鉛及鋅的精礦。
本公司普通股在加拿大的多倫多證券交易所（"TSX"）及美國的納斯達克全球選選市場（"Nasdaq"）上市，代號為 "SSRM"。SSR Mining 自願從澳洲證券交易所（"ASX"）除牌，代號為 "SSR"，自 2025 年 4 月 8 日起生效。
本報告中，"SSR Mining"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們"及 "我們"均指 SSR Mining Inc. 連同其關係企業及子公司，除非文意另有說明。本報告中所有貨幣參考皆為美國美元（"USD"），除非另有說明。提及 "CAD" 或使用符號 "C$" 均指加拿大美元。提及 "TRY" 均指土耳其的法定貨幣，土耳其里拉。提及 "ARS" 均指阿根廷的法定貨幣，阿根廷比索。

本公司營運包含五個應報告分部及生產礦場，分別為位於土耳其厄爾祖倫省的 Çöpler（"Çöpler"）、位於美國內華達州的 Marigold（"Marigold"）、位於美國科羅拉多州的 Crippler Creek & Victor（"CC&V"）、位於加拿大薩斯喀徹溫省的 Seabee（"Seabee"）以及位於阿根廷胡胡伊省的 Puna（"Puna"）－每個礦場均為應報告分部，同時也被稱為生產資產。各應報告分部對 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止年度營收的貢獻為：Çöpler 貢獻 0%（2024 年為 7%；2023 年為 31%），Marigold 貢獻 33%（2024 年為 41%；2023 年為 38%），CC&V 貢獻 28%，Seabee 貢獻 11%（2024 年為 19%；2023 年為 11%），Puna 貢獻 28%（2024 年為 33%；2023 年為 20%）。有關應報告分部的更多資訊，請參閱財務報表附註 4。
本公司亦參與位於美國、阿根廷、加拿大及土耳其的產地之探勘及開發活動。有關本公司生產、探勘及開發產地的更多資訊，請參閱第 2 項「財產」。

Çöpler、Marigold、CC&V 及 Seabee 皆生產金 doré。Doré 為未精煉的金塊，通常含有超過 90% 的金，之後由第三方進一步精煉為金塊。本公司將 Marigold、CC&V 及 Seabee 產生的金 doré 主要銷售給銀行，並將 Çöpler 產生的金 doré（當其運作時）銷售給土耳其中央銀行。Puna 產生銀、鉛及鋅的精礦，這些精礦銷售給熔煉廠或貿易商進一步精煉。

2025 年，金 doré 的銷售佔總營收約 71%，其中 33% 銷售給加拿大豐業銀行（"CIBC"），13% 銷售給加拿大皇家銀行（"RBC"），以及 12% 銷售給加拿大國家銀行（"NBC"）。銀的銷售佔營收約 24%，其中 10% 銷售給 Trafigura Trading LLC。2024 年，金 doré 的銷售佔營收 67%，其中 30% 銷售給 CIBC，13% 銷售給 Asahi Refining。2023 年，金 doré 的銷售佔營收 80%，其中 33% 銷售給 CIBC，31% 銷售給土耳其中央銀行。
本公司透過與亞洲及歐洲的熔煉廠及貿易商的契約安排，銷售含有高銀含量的鉛及鋅精礦。這些精礦透過年度更新的供應契約或根據市場需求透過現貨銷售，其加工費用根據全球市場對精礦的需求而定。
本公司各類產品之營業收入於以下年份之情形如下：
(1) 本公司亦從銅取得微小之營業收入。
(2) 其他營業收入包括：因黃金與基本金屬價格變動導致 concentrate trade receivables 公允價值變動；以及因生產與銷售黃金 doré 而產生之銀與銅副產品收入。
有關各營運資產之礦物資源與礦物儲備資訊，請參閱第 2 項 "按礦物分類之已證與可能儲備估計" 以及 "按礦物分類之資源估計"。

黃金與銀之市場價格為本公司獲利之關鍵驅動因素。黃金與銀之價格可能波動極大，並受多種總體經濟因素影響，包括全球或區域消費模式、黃金與銀之供應與需求、利率、匯率、通貨膨脹或通貨緊縮，以及全球主要黃金與銀生產國與消費國之政治與經濟條件。重要的是，黃金與銀之價格可能受其在市場動盪時期作為避險資產之角色，以及作為對抗政府與中央銀行當局對各種經濟威脅所採取措施所導致之通貨膨脹影響與貨幣貶值之防禦工具之影響。有關進一步資訊，請參閱第 1A 項 "風險因素"。

paragraphs: SSR Mining 是一家貴金屬採礦公司，擁有位於美國、土耳其、加拿大和阿根廷的五處運營場地。本公司主要從事在土耳其及美洲地區貴金屬資源產地的運營、收購、勘探與開發業務。本公司生產金 doré 以及銅、銀、鉛和鋅的 concentrates。
在 2025 年第二季，由於礦場北側森林大火導致電力中斷，本公司暫時中斷了 Seabee 的運營，約兩週時間。本公司於 2025 年 6 月 13 日恢復運營，未對本公司財產造成損害。

於 2025 年 2 月 28 日（"收購日"），本公司從 Newmont Corporation 收購了 Cripple Creek and Victor Gold Mining Company（"CC&V"）所有已發行及流通的普通股，支付現金 1 億美元作為初步對價，並可能根據批准修改礦場許可申請以延長礦場壽命及取得相關流動許可要求的法規緩衝，支付最高達 1.75 億美元的現金里程碑付款。有關 CC&V 收購的更多細節，請參閱財務報表附註 3。

於 2024 年 2 月 13 日，本公司因 Çöpler 事件暫停了其 Çöpler 項目所有運營。與土耳其當局合作，本公司正努力進行現場整治，包括永久關閉堆積浸出場地及停止堆積浸出處理。本公司持續與相關當局密切合作，恢復必要的法規許可並推動 Çöpler 礦場重啟。目前，本公司無法預估或預測何時能恢復 Çöpler 項目的運營。有關 Çöpler 事件的更多資訊，請參閱第一部分 商業 – Çöpler 事件。

於 2024 年 5 月 23 日，本公司完成將位於祕魯中部安卡什部門的桑路易斯礦場出售給 Highlander Silver Corp.（"Highlander Silver"）之交易，交易對價為現金 5.0 百萬美元，以及最高達 37.5 百萬美元之現金支付之條件性對價。於交易完成日，條件性對價之公允價值為 2.4 百萬美元，並將於開始進行桑路易斯礦場之初步鑽探工程起，分六期支付，並於商業生產後第二年結束。本公司所收取之對價不包含某些依可行性研究完成及商業生產之完成而支付之款項。本公司保留桑路易斯礦場 4% 之淨採礦回報權利（"NSR"），其中一半可由 Highlander Silver 以 15.0 百萬美元之價格於開始建設前任何時間購回。
有關上述收購及出售的更多資訊，請參閱財務報表附註 3。

paragraphs: 本公司面臨許多風險與不確定性，若任何風險實際發生，可能會對本公司的業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生重大不利影響。您應仔細審閱本節所列風險，並配合本年度報告其他節次所包含資訊一併考量。這些風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險，且可能尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要，也可能影響本公司的業務，其影響可能為重大。
以下為本公司所面臨某些主要風險之摘要，這些風險可能對本公司業務、營運成果、現金流及/或財務狀況產生負面影響：
•因Çöpler事件之影響，本公司面臨新的且持續存在的風險。
與本公司營運及業務相關之風險：
•本公司之生產、開發計畫及成本預估可能有所變動且/或無法達成。
•黃金、銀及其他金屬之市場價格變動，過去曾有大幅波動，將影響本公司之營運。
